info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Account Transactions API
info.description: The Customer Account Transactions API facilitates the submission of transaction records for specific customer accounts. By leveraging this API, businesses can seamlessly add new transactions, thereby enhancing account activity tracking and financial reporting. It primarily supports financial institutions and service providers that require detailed transaction management for individual customer accounts. Use cases include processing customer payments, recording purchase activities, and maintaining comprehensive financial histories.

post.summary: Create a new transaction for a specific customer account.
post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of a transaction associated with a specific account of a customer. Users can submit transaction details to be recorded under the specified account.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new transaction for a specific account associated with a customer. It requires the details of the transaction, including the amount, type, and other relevant information.
